suite: popover mechanics (the stack page's citation card)
expect_red: the card's crop element IS the picture — its box still carries the crop's own aspect ratio

mutations.contract: A card's crop is capped by WIDTH, so the figure the highlight overlay is positioned against stays the picture itself -- a percentage box lands on the cell it names rather than in a letterbox beside it.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_preview_pane_replaces_the_hover_popups_and_one_record_backs_every_mark (2026-10-30). Re-anchored from 'the crop's element IS the picture -- ...', measured on the topology grid's edge card until that card retired (2026-10-30); the same rule on the citation card, the card with a crop that is left. The pre-2026-09-15 rule capped the HEIGHT and let `object-fit: contain` inset the picture inside an element that kept the block's full width.
